# Context menu

A menu of actions on right-click or long-press.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Context menu is for power users, and people who don't know to right-click never find it. Brand expressive serves new customers deciding if they care. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./button">Button</a>, <a href="./popover">Popover</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Power users acting on an item in place, with the same actions also reachable elsewhere.
- **Not when:** The only way to reach an action: people who don't know to right-click never find it.

Instead:

- [Dropdown menu](./dropdown-menu.md): The same actions from a visible button.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Shift F10 or the menu key opens it; arrows move; Escape closes. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add context-menu
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Context menu reads 1 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Context menu's tokens to change Context menu alone.
